title: An Axe to Find
description: Glover Mallory asks the player to retrieve his ancient Nordic pickaxe from Crescius Caerellius, who borrowed it and refuses to return it. The player can either return the pickaxe to Glover or let Crescius keep it and lie to Glover about it.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Raven Rock.
I have connections with the Thieves Guild in Riften.
Crescius Caerellius borrowed my ancient Nordic pickaxe and hasn't returned it.
The ancient Nordic pickaxe is the only tool that can crack stalhrim.
I traded for the pickaxe with residents from Skaal Village.

QUEST_STARTED: I've asked someone to retrieve my pickaxe from Crescius.
RETURN_PICKAXE: The pickaxe has been returned. I let them keep it as a reward since it hasn't done me any good in years.
LIE_TO_GLOVER: Crescius refused to return the pickaxe. I paid for the trouble anyway.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Quest finishes after player resolves the pickaxe situation with Glover.
Although Glover lets you keep the pickaxe as a reward for finishing the quest, you can choose not to return the pickaxe and keep it that way instead.
If you return the pickaxe, Glover explains that he only wanted to teach Crescuis a lesson that stealing is wrong.

base_facts: I am an old ex-miner living in Raven Rock.
I borrowed Glover Mallory's ancient Nordic pickaxe.
I believe the pickaxe was made for mining, not selling.
I think Glover stole the pickaxe from the Skaal in the first place.

SPEAK_TO_CRESCIUS: I've explained my position on the pickaxe to someone.

beats.comment: Quest starts when player agrees to help Glover retrieve his pickaxe from Crescius.
Player finds Crescius and discusses the pickaxe with him.
Player returns the pickaxe to Glover honestly and gets to keep it as a reward.
Player lies to Glover and lets Crescius keep the pickaxe, receiving gold instead.
Quest finishes after player resolves the pickaxe situation with Glover.
